title: THE FASHION RACKS FILL THE PANEL
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): the menus still look bad, take pictures and make it look like a triple A game. The picture review of Fashion found the rack tiles so narrow that what unlocks a tile ran into both borders or broke into five lines over its name, the racks used only the left half of the panel, and a locked tile looked almost the same as one you own. The tiles are wider and share the whole panel width, the unlock line fits inside the tile, and a locked tile shows a small lock. No word changed.
now: The Fashion racks fill the panel with wider tiles, and locked tiles show a lock.
